fresh_isolation.rule: No fresh:280..319 task may be instantiated by R16 training, calibration, tests, or development.

mechanism.goal: learn public transition dynamics rather than direct action residuals
mechanism.parent_fallback: accepted R11 remains exact fallback whenever ensemble disagrees, confidence is below train-only calibration threshold, or posterior support exceeds candidate gate
mechanism.ensemble_role: three independently initialized neural world models must agree on the full three-coordinate transition delta before a neural counterfactual can be used
mechanism.anti_overfit_rationale: R12 overfit direct action labels; R16 supervises environment transition structure using only public train-split interactions

promotion_gate: strict total solved gain over accepted R11 on dev:864..895
conditional_regimes, regime_switch, causal_prerequisites solved counts exactly equal accepted R11

confirmation.rule: exact frozen checkpoint, calibration threshold, and selected config only; no retraining or reselection

claim_boundary: R16 is development-only. It adds learned public world-model parameters but does not change the accepted R4 checkpoint. Fresh remains unopened until exact-checkpoint disjoint confirmation passes.
